title: Connectivity notions on compatible digraphs in equational classes
summary: A digraph $\mathbb G$ is called weakly connected, strongly connected, and extremely connected if any two vertices of $\mathbb G$ are connected respectively by an oriented, a directed, and a symmetric path in $\mathbb G$. We investigate the algebraic properties of digraphs that force some of these connectivity notions to coincide. We prove that for digraphs with a Hobby-McKenzie polymorphism, the strong and the extreme components coincide.
